purpose: Synthetic behavioral review inputs, not model performance results

cases.scenario: Existing context says the user enjoys detailed technical explanations. User: When we are discussing my robotics experiments, start with what the robot actually did and explain one unfamiliar term at a time. The deeper technical breakdown can come when I ask.

After several demanding conversations, user: I am fed up with every conversation turning into self-improvement. For the rest of tonight, can we just talk about the film? No earlier statement rejects coaching generally.

Assistant: You could spend half an hour on Sunday reviewing those project ideas. User: That sounds useful. I am still figuring out whether this weekend is realistic. A later task review asks what the user has committed to doing.

An older chat summary says the user wants firm accountability whenever a project stalls. The old preference is already stored.
